test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the passage correctly:
(1) She started speaking as the audience settled in.
(2) The moment she stepped into the meeting room, she activated the projector.
(3) She opened the slideshow in full screen mode to have clearer visibility.
(4) She plugged her laptop into the projector with an HDMI cable.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sequence of events in the passage must follow a logical order based on the flow of actions.
 
• **Sentence 2** is the first sentence because it describes the initiation of the process, i.e., stepping into the meeting room and activating the projector.
 
 
• "The moment she stepped into the meeting room, she activated the projector."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4** follows as the next step since it describes physically connecting the laptop to the projector.
 
 
• "She plugged her laptop into the projector with an HDMI cable."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3** is the third in the sequence, as it mentions setting the slideshow to full screen mode for visibility.
 
 
• "She opened the slideshow in full screen mode to have clearer visibility."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 1** is the last sentence because it describes the final action of starting the speech after everything was set up.
 
 
• "She started speaking as the audience settled in."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **2 - 4 - 3 - 1**.

 

**Coherent sequence after rearrangement**:

"The moment she stepped into the meeting room, she activated the projector. She plugged her laptop into the projector with an HDMI cable. She opened the slideshow in full screen mode to have clearer visibility. She started speaking as the audience settled in."</div
